summary: This study looks at how drinking certain liquids or receiving sugar through an IV before stomach or gut surgery affects blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes. The trial plans to enroll 126 participants aged 18 to 75 years. The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University is sponsoring the research. The current status of the trial is Not yet recruiting.

facts.sponsor: The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University
